# ClearMarket

Reference data layer for prediction markets. Cross-venue event linking, structured resolution sources, daily marks across Kalshi and Polymarket.

## What this is

ClearMarket normalizes Kalshi and Polymarket markets into a single 4-table schema:
- events: canonical question, classified, with catalysts and editorial notes
- markets: one row per venue listing, with parsed resolution rules and named sources
- marks: daily price + liquidity snapshot per market
- resolution_log: append-only audit trail of lifecycle events

Same event priced on both venues = one event_id, two markets, two marks.

## API (free tier, v0.2.0-beta)

Base: https://clearmarket.fyi/api/v1/

- GET /api/v1/index.json — discovery doc: endpoints, version, schema URLs
- GET /api/v1/events.json — list of canonical events with summary marks
- GET /api/v1/events/{slug}.json — full event detail: event + markets + marks + resolution_log
- GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/markets.json — markets only for one event

Static cached JSON. CORS open. Refresh daily. Soft rate limit ~100 req/day per IP at CDN edge.

## Example slugs

- fed-april-2026-rate-decision (15 markets across Kalshi and Polymarket)
- sp-500-close-end-of-2026 (27 strike markets)
- netanyahu-out-by-april-30
- iran-x-israelus-conflict-ends-by-april-30-766-662-668-546

Full event list: https://clearmarket.fyi/api/v1/events.json
